--drop view

IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'EDS' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TRU_CUST' )
BEGIN
DROP VIEW [EDS].[TRU_CUST];
END; GO



CREATE TABLE [EDS].[TRU_CUST]
( 
	[SUB_BR_CD]                         	VARCHAR(10),
	[CUST_NO]                  			VARCHAR(30),
	[RM_ID]                             	VARCHAR(200),
	[UNIQUE_ID]                         	VARCHAR(40),
	[ADVISOR_ID]                        	VARCHAR(200),
	[REF_UNIT]                          	VARCHAR(10),
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [char](1)  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([UNIQUE_ID]),
	HEAP
);
GO
